role: Renders an EntityEnderman: the enderman model (with the screaming mouth offset), the glowing eyes overlay, and the carried block in its hands rendered as a 3D block.
scope_reason: Endermen are gated content (fight-enderman-s1 and the mob scenes).

members.name: endermanEyesTexture
members.note: TEX_ENDERMAN_EYES, the additive eyes overlay pass in raster_mobs_draw

members.name: endermanModel
members.note: model_enderman carries the geometry including the screaming mouth offset (screaming ? 5 : 0)

members.name: rnd
members.note: a determinized RNG (netherite.oracle.Det.newRandom) from the oracle's determinism pass; the native render path consumes recorded state instead of re-rolling

members.name: doRender
members.note: the model plus the carried block and eyes layers, drawn through raster_mobs_draw

members.name: renderEquippedItems
members.note: draw_carried_block's comment names RenderEnderman.renderEquippedItems and renders the carried block through the block atlas icons at the carried rotation

members.name: shouldRenderPass
members.note: the additive eyes layer (TEX_ENDERMAN_EYES), no depth write, drawn in raster_mobs_draw's shared layer pass

notes: The carried block's id and meta and the screaming flag arrive as dump fields (carried_id, screaming) on mob_render_input (raster_mobs.h). fight-enderman-s1 covers the teleport/fight behaviour; the render scenes gate the pixels.
